column1: # What Specular ships besides Rust crates (whose credits come from Cargo), and what Cargo can't tell
# about some crates. Read when a device is built, by crates/specular-credits, for the credits screen and
# licences.txt. Columns are separated by tabs; "-" leaves one empty. Licence texts are paths in this
# A project: kind, name, licence (SPDX), web address, licence texts. The kind is specular, core:<name>,
# font, data or library. A core's <name> is the one tools/build-cores.sh builds it as, and its version
# and web address come from there; every core that script builds needs a line here. A core's line has
# one more column, before the licence texts: its copyright notice, copied from the core's source, which
# the splash shows while one of its games starts. The splash finds the line by its name, which must be
# A crate: "crate", its name, the licence it is used under (when it offers several, or declares none),
# and its licence texts (when its package ships none). A line covers every version of the crate, and
# one for a crate no longer linked is ignored.
# Slint offers three licences; Specular uses it under GPL-3.0-only, whose text is Specular's LICENSE.
